builds.name: Ebb and Flow ceiling
builds.summary: Third bounce heal is (155+.4 AP) multiplied twice by 1+(-20+.15 AP)*.01. AP increases both base and bounce growth, making Deathcap valuable beyond linear healing.
builds.goal: Third bounce heal is (155+.4 AP) multiplied twice by 1+(-20+.15 AP)*.01. AP increases both base and bounce growth, making Deathcap valuable beyond linear healing.
builds.hypothesis:
Nami unleashes a stream of water that bounces between allied and enemy champions. Each champion can only be hit once, and it hits up to [3] targets.Restores [55 / 80 / 105 / 130 / 155 + (0.4) × AP] Health to allies and will bounce to a nearby enemy champion. Deals [60 / 95 / 130 / 165 / 200 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage to enemies and will bounce to a nearby allied champion.
The damage and healing value is modified by [(-20 + (0.15) × AP) × (0.01)] each bounce.
Deathcap supplies multiplicative AP; Dawncore converts the support items base mana regen into AP/heal power; Redemption/Mikael/Ardent/Staff supply heal power, with actives excluded. Aery/Revitalize favor eligible protection; Gathering Storm fixed to 30min raises AP; Manaflow is only useful on mana users.

ceiling.finiteState: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

testPlan: Finite benchmark: Level 18, selected ability max rank; minute 30, no external ally buffs or dragons, 3000 max-HP target with 1500 bonus HP, 100 armor/50 MR and 29% starting HP unless objective overrides. Heartsteel exactly 500 earned HP if present; self 10% HP for Bloodmail. Seraph earned from fully stacked Tear. Rune gathering time fixed at 30min; item combat ramps ready.

Bounce ally-enemy-ally with third ally injured and distinct; compare first and third heal, exclude item chains. Log raw kit packet(s), post-mitigation damage and separate item/rune packets; repeat at 100% target HP and swap one item at a time. First Strike must be ready and champion initiates; compare eligible bonus separately.

Isolate the named ability/passive packet from item procs, rune damage and the rest of the combo. Record raw versus post-resistance damage, actual crit outcome, charge, rank and target state. Healing/shield/execute thresholds are separate metrics, not damage.

Use the stated benchmark, not free infinite stacks or allied buffs. The initial form fields are editable defaults (level18, target3000HP/100armor/50MR); adjust them and record every other requirement before measuring.
failureConditions: The candidate loses the intended packet gain after real mitigation, charge restrictions, proc behavior or buff eligibility is measured.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
tradeoffs: Six completed items assume late boots sell/swap; movement and practical survival/access are sacrificed for the number. Rabadon's Deathcap, Dawncore, Redemption, Mikael's Blessing, Ardent Censer, Staff of Flowing Water. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Healing is capped by missing HP; self Visage does not amplify another ally heal.
Confidence: plausible. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.
buyOrder: This is a late six-item ceiling loadout. Compare individual item swaps at fixed level, earned stacks and target conditions; the displayed order is not a lane shopping order.
Keep boots and role starters during the actual game. A damage-slot boot replacement requires a deliberate late benchmark and may make the ability impossible to land.
coverageNotes: These targets are manual experiments. Existing Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W numeric adapters cannot certify these whole loadouts, omitted item/rune effects or global maxima.

Highest-number candidate, not proof of mathematical maximum. Use current stored source values and verify all conditional multipliers. Unlimited game time changes Gathering Storm; no finite global maximum over unrestricted time. Damage cannot exceed remaining HP as an observed health loss; record theoretical packet separately. Crit does not automatically multiply spells/pets/procs.
Unbounded stacks, game time or target health prevent a universal finite maximum; keep their chosen caps explicit.
